# Digilent rgb2dvi

`rgb2dvi/` is copied unchanged from Digilent's vivado-library:
https://github.com/Digilent/vivado-library

Pinned upstream commit: `0362ce72d39eebc400fdabacff706ee7fa8ad564`.
Source directory: `ip/rgb2dvi`.

The source files carry the BSD 3-clause license and copyright notices. The
`ResetBridge` entity is included in the core's `src/SyncAsyncReset.vhd`.
